fn solve(k: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires (k >= 1)
  ensures (len(result) == k)
  ensures forall i in 0..k: (result[i] > 0)
  ensures forall i in 0..(k - 1): (result[i] < result[(i + 1)])
  ensures ((not (k >= 1)) or (result[0] == 1))
  ensures ((not (k >= 2)) or (result[1] == 2))
  ensures ((not (k >= 3)) or (result[2] == 3))
  ensures ((not (k >= 4)) or (result[3] == 4))
  ensures ((not (k >= 5)) or (result[4] == 5))
  ensures ((not (k >= 6)) or (result[5] == 6))
  ensures ((not (k >= 7)) or (result[6] == 7))
  ensures ((not (k >= 8)) or (result[7] == 8))
  ensures ((not (k >= 9)) or (result[8] == 9))
  ensures ((not (k >= 10)) or (result[9] == 19))
  effects pure
  example (solve(0) == [])
